latest_message:
Dear Laszlo,

Thank you for reaching out and for letting us know. We are truly sorry to hear about your accident and wish you a smooth and speedy recovery.

Please feel free to complete the AI interview when you are ready and feeling well. The interview can be taken at your convenience using the link from your original invitation email, and there is no strict deadline, so please take the time you need.

If you need any assistance locating the interview link, please do not hesitate to let us know.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

--
Jessica from Flowmingo Customer Support Team
